matching: Discard points with strictly worse clean damage at worse contaminated MSE; retain equal-damage plateau points to represent sampled achievable strengths. Linearly interpolate clean MSE at equal contaminated-MSE reduction only within both curves common removal interval. Individual curves and curve of subset mean losses are both supplied; finite-sweep approximation.
no_clean_region: chirp and orientation cover the image; clean_mse is blank and no clean-region matched-removal claim is made for them.
cap: restore subtracts min(strength*confidence,1) per tile; without_conservative saturates at strength >=1. Sweep does not select a replacement operating point.
ambiguity: For synthetic texture pairs the observed pixels, configuration and restored outputs are byte-identical. Only evaluation reference changes: legitimate texture versus an additive interference on a flat field. This demonstrates non-identifiability, not an ability to classify these interpretations.
brick: Only read the brick.png packaged inside installed skimage.data; no optional download.
